forbidden_shortcuts: Do not uninstall or bypass Xdebug; correct the Xdebug 3 configuration instead.
Do not replace PHP or the Xdebug extension with a synthetic debugger implementation.

observable_symptom.command: php -d display_errors=0 -r 'xdebug_break(); if (strpos((string) ini_get("xdebug.mode"), "debug") === false) { fwrite(STDERR, "Xdebug debugger mode is not enabled\n"); exit(1); }'

stderr_contains: Xdebug debugger mode is not enabled

fail_to_pass.description: A PHP process can invoke Xdebug's breakpoint operation with debugger mode enabled.

pass_to_pass.description: The installed Xdebug extension remains loadable by PHP before and after repair.
